query: Existing P08 warehouse_id, source/filters, limit/cursor and optional explicit activityId remain unchanged. No new client identity override.

identity.record_id: SOURCE:canonical persisted owner UUID, already authorized by the filtered P08 read query.
identity.owner_id: Canonical parent UUID. Never the activity/event/draft/auth-session/notification recipient ID.
identity.warehouse_id: Confirmed and authorized warehouse from P08 scope, validated against persisted source ownership before the projection.
identity.uniqueness: One distinct record/source/business/owner tuple before cursor pagination; ambiguity fails 503 HISTORY_RECORD_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED.

DOCUMENT.detail: INBOUND -> inbound-documents/{owner_id}; OUTBOUND -> outbound-documents/{owner_id}; requires documents.read in addition to existing history/source rights.
DOCUMENT.attachments: Same exact parent + /attachments; requires documents.read. Owner independently reauthorizes.

WARRANTY.detail: warranty-cases/{owner_id}, after existing history + warranty source scope.

NFC.nfc_history: nfc-tags/{owner_id}/events under /api/v1/mini-app; no invented tag detail/confirmation route.

SCAN.scan_session: history/scan-sessions/{owner_id} under /api/v1/mini-app; batch UUID, not auth family.

targets.unavailable: Other target types are available=false with read_target=null. No guessed P20 component business ID or item ID.

compatibility: selectedActivity remains null when activityId is omitted, even with one event. Explicit activityId still must belong to the exact record. Existing events/paging/count semantics are preserved.
